slides.title: What Is at Stake Tuesday
slides.body: All 435 House seats and about a third of the Senate are on the ballot. Polls point to a change in House control. The Senate is less certain.

slides.title: What Investors Expect
slides.subtitle: % expecting a Democratic win (forecasts)
slides.body: Wolfe Research surveyed 138 investors. These are forecasts, not results.

slides.title: Why It Matters
slides.body: Analysts say divided government tends to limit major policy shifts, which markets usually welcome. Watch AI rules, tariffs, healthcare spending and the Fed.

slides.title: What to Watch Next
items: Nov 3: Election Day. House and Senate control.
Nov 6: October jobs report, 8:30 a.m. ET.
